x: Darren Gauson had hoped for a fast time in the A 800 but a tactical first lap of 58 secs. put paid to that. Forced to lead out on lap 2 he opened up a small gap and was only pipped on the line by Alasdair Donaldson – a 1.47.3 man – so a great performance there.
